description: Count of items a horticultural college asks an applicant to bring to an interview, from its applicant checklist. DISTILL-CANARY-e5138bd0

files.checklist.txt:
Items to hand in at the interview
Portfolio of drawn work
Letter from the previous school
Photographic identification
Access assessment form
Items to hand in before the course starts
Steel boots and overalls
Studio materials deposit
files.visiting-notes.md:
# Visiting the college

The college runs a minibus from the station on interview days.
Candidate parking is behind the glasshouse.

turns.prompt: Thornholme College of Horticulture interviews applicants through the winter for its spring intake. How many items does the college ask a candidate to bring to the interview?
